verdict.rationale: WorkOS's own docs show AuthKit can enroll users in multi-factor authentication, enabled from the Authentication page of the WorkOS dashboard, and pricing lists MFA as part of AuthKit. That establishes a first-party MFA capability. However, the evidence does not name TOTP authenticator apps, backup codes, or step-up enforcement, so only the generic MFA core of the story is covered. Missing for 10: explicit TOTP authenticator-app support, backup or recovery codes, step-up enforcement for sensitive actions, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
